headline: 13 Michigan deals, $160.3M raised — led by Sygaldry Technologies, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Sygaldry Technologies, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based technology company, filed a $139M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $139M sold to 165 investors.
Food Capital Partners Holdings LLC, an Oxford-based business services company, filed a $22M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $10.8M sold to 7 investors.
O2 Atlas Paving Holdings, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based fund, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $11.3M of equity and pooled fund interests issued to 8 investors.
W Silverbell LLC, a Bingham Farms-based commercial real estate company, filed a $8.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $8.5M sold to 85 investors.
High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $8.1M of equity and options/warrants issued to 1 investor.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $160.3M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, up 782% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Sygaldry Technologies, Inc. (Ann Arbor, Other Technology) targeting $139M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
O2 Atlas Paving Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan private funds assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $11.8M raised so far — led by O2 Atlas Paving Holdings, LLC (Business Combination (Form D)). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
